title: Corpus Quality Improves, Retrieval Utility Does Not: An Ablation of Preprocessing and Refinement in a Speech-to-QA Pipeline
abstract: arXiv:2610.27652v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Practitioners building training corpora with a pipeline of language models keep a preprocessing or refinement (post-process) stage when switching it on raises the corpus quality. We ablate a production pipeline that turns conference speech into question-answer pairs. The preprocessing stage rewrites the transcript, and the refinement stage filters the generated pairs. Switching each on and off gives four corpora from the same 40 Korean medical and finance sessions. On the corpus itself, quality rises as the stages switch on. Four LLM judges and six human domain experts rank the four corpora the same way, and the fully refined corpus leads by +0.18 and +0.22 on a 1-5 scale. We then ask whether that gain carries downstream. We supply each corpus to six models at inference and measure retrieval accuracy. The ranking does not hold. translated_title: 语料库质量提升，检索效用并未提升：语音转问答流水线中预处理与精炼阶段的消融研究
translated_abstract: 使用语言模型流水线构建训练语料库的实践者，会在开启预处理或精炼（后处理）阶段能够提升语料库质量时保留该阶段。我们对一条将会议语音转换为问答对的生产级流水线进行了消融实验。预处理阶段负责改写转录文本，精炼阶段负责过滤生成的问答对。通过分别开启和关闭这两个阶段，我们从相同的40个韩语医疗和金融会议中得到了四个语料库。就语料库本身而言，随着各阶段的开启，质量随之提升。四个大语言模型评审与六位人类领域专家对四个语料库给出了相同的排序，完全精炼的语料库在1-5分制上分别领先+0.18和+0.22。随后我们探究这一提升能否传递到下游任务。我们将每个语料库提供给六个模型进行推理并测量检索准确率，结果该排序不再成立。开启转录文本改写会使检索准确率降低0.061，这是唯一在校正后仍然显著的阶段效应……
tldr: 本研究通过消融实验发现，尽管预处理和精炼阶段能显著提升语料库质量并获得LLM评审与人类专家的一致认可，但这种质量提升并不能转化为下游检索准确率的提升，其中转录改写反而使检索准确率下降了0.061。
en_tdlr: Through ablation experiments, this study finds that although preprocessing and refinement stages significantly improve corpus quality as consistently ranked by both LLM judges and human experts, these gains do not transfer to downstream retrieval accuracy—in fact, enabling transcript rewriting lowers retrieval accuracy by 0.061.
